name: Belts and pulleys
summary: V-belts, flat, ribbed and toothed belts, and the pulleys they run on.
uses: Gearing a motor up or down for a generator or pump
Driving a saw, grinder or fan from one motor
identify: Washing machines, dryers, treadmills, mowers, vacuum cleaners, car engines, printers and air compressors. Belts have a size code printed on the back; the ratio of pulley sizes sets the speed change.
test: Flex the belt and look for cracks, glazing and missing ribs. A pulley should sit straight on its shaft without wobble, with its set screw or key intact.

decay.note: Rubber belts crack and stretch over years; pulleys last.
